comments.body: 2026-11-11: done on main (c1b1b04c). The spawned thread joins, the main queue finishes; Renderer's teardown no longer waits in deinit (SurfaceFrees). SurfaceGUITests checks the completion arrives on the main thread.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Rebasing patch 0002 as written would compile, pass every tier, and ship a freeze and a use-after-free. Redesign it.

Upstream did not fix the deadlock 0002 works around (a_2Y9XNJ2YI): the app mailbox is still a blocking 64-entry queue drained only by a tick, and `Surface.deinit` still joins the IO thread on the caller. So Muster still needs the patch.

Upstream did add a rule. #14691 routes every CVDisplayLink start and stop through the main thread. src/renderer/DisplayLink.zig says `close` "Must be called on the main thread", and generic.zig's `renderer.deinit` calls it with the comment "Surfaces are destroyed on the main thread". 0002 runs `core_surface.deinit()` on a spawned thread. That brings back the collision #14691 removed, and `close` can free the struct while `syncCallback` runs on the main queue. Both need a display reconfiguration during a free, which no tier stages.

Proposed, not built: join off the main thread, finish on it.
1. Split `Surface.deinit` into one function that stops and joins the threads and one with the rest. `deinit` calls both.
2. `ghostty_surface_free_detached` keeps its main-thread half.
3. The spawned thread runs only the join half, then `dispatch_async_f` to the main queue.
4. That callback runs the rest of `Surface.deinit`, `alloc.destroy(ptr)` and `done`.

Consequences: `done` now fires on the main queue, and Renderer.swift:255's `isolated deinit` spins on `frees.value` with `usleep` on the main thread, so a completion cannot run during that spin. Renderer.swift:144's comment and observations section 15 become false. The header hunk needs nullability annotations inside `assume_nonnull`, or `rendererSurfaceFreed` stops matching. Splitting `Surface.deinit` also bends the rule that patches only add C API; it changes no behavior, but it will conflict on later re-pins.

Verify with SurfaceGUITests plus a check that the completion arrives on the main thread.
title: Patch 0002 frees a surface off the main thread, which vt-1.0.0 forbids
